no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],

 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

The trial met both dual primary endpoints — composites of CHD death/MI/ischemic stroke and that plus ischemia-driven revascularization — per the October 2025 announcement. The calculator predicted robust success (expected HR 0.759, 24% RRR) based on FOURIER's -59% LDL-C reduction applied to the VESALIUS-CV entry threshold, the longer 4.5-year follow-up (time factor 0.939), and 751 planned events yielding 96.5% power. No new safety signals were reported.
